scenes.heading: Choosing a platform and niche to focus on first

sents.d: Choosing a platform and niche to focus on first
Depth on one platform usually beats a thin presence spread across many.

Each major platform rewards different content formats and has a different audience mindset — short-form video platforms favor fast, hook-driven content, while others favor longer or more polished formats, and trying to master all of them at once dilutes effort.

A specific, well-defined niche (not just 'lifestyle' but a clear angle within it) makes it easier for an algorithm to identify your ideal audience and for potential brand partners to understand exactly who they'd be reaching through you.

Choosing a platform and niche based on genuine, sustained interest matters more than chasing whatever is currently trending, since consistent content over months or years is what actually builds an audience, and interest is what sustains that consistency.

take: Pick one platform and a specific niche you'll stick with.
